    AI Overview
    In the 500th episode of
    NCIS ("All Good Things," Season 23, Episode 13, aired March 24, 2026), Director Leon Vance (played by Rocky Carroll) was killed in the line of duty. After discovering CID Agent Dolan Thompson was corrupt, Vance was shot multiple times in the chest by him while trying to save the NCIS agency. 
    Key Details of Director Vance's Death: 
    • The Killer: CID Agent Dolan Thompson, who was revealed to be working against the agency.
    • The Cause: Shot multiple times in the chest during a confrontation, with agents Parker and McGee arriving too late to save him.
    • The Sacrifice: Vance died protecting the agency from being shut down, with showrunner Steven D. Binder emphasizing the death was a heroic sacrifice.
    • Afterlife Scene: Following his death, Vance was welcomed into the afterlife by a vision of a young Dr. Ducky Mallard.
    • Final Appearance: This marked the end of Rocky Carroll's 18-season run as a series regular on the show. 
    The death occurred during a milestone episode designed to shake up the series and create high stakes in its 23rd season.

    Why was Vance killed off NCIS?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Director Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) was killed off in NCIS Season 23, Episode 500 (March 2026) to create a "spectacular" and shocking moment for the show’s milestone, marking an end to his 18-season tenure. Producers wanted to elevate the stakes by having Vance make the ultimate sacrifice to save the agency, rather than having the character simply resign or retire. 
    Key Details on Vance's Exit: 
    • Creative Decision: The death was not Rocky Carroll's choice, but a storyline proposed by showrunner Steven D. Binder to shake up the series.
    • The 500th Episode:
      The producers wanted an "epic" and "mythic" plot to mark the 500th episode milestone, ensuring it sent "shockwaves through the NCIS fan base".
    • The Sacrifice: In the episode, Vance was killed in a shooting while fighting to save the NCIS agency from being shut down by the Department of Defense.
    • Character Legacy: Carroll, who played Vance for 18 seasons, supported the decision after reading the script, viewing it as a "great" and "terrific" story that honored the character's long tenure.
    • Future Return: Although his character died, Carroll stated he is not leaving the NCIS family entirely and will return to direct future episodes. 
    Carroll described the, "All Good Things," episode as a, "really well-written," way to end his character's journey, which he likened to, "living to be 105," in show terms.
